description: This Java source file defines a functional interface for creating Akka actor Props objects that handle individual HTTP requests within the Eclipse Ditto gateway service. It includes method signatures for constructing actor Props with relevant parameters such as the proxy actor, header translator, HTTP request, response future, and configuration objects.

classes.name: HttpRequestActorPropsFactory
classes.description: A functional interface for creating Props objects for actors that handle HTTP requests.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Constructs a Props object for an actor responsible for handling a specific HTTP request, given the proxy actor, header translator, HTTP request, response future, and configuration objects.
